text.p: RABAT, July 31 Reuter) - These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri says the two draft laws shaping representation in the future bicameral parliament will ensure balance of powers.
- French Foreign Minister Hubert Vedrine ends visit to Morocco on promise to pursue dialogue aiming to ease visa procedures for Moroccans.
- National Commission in charge of following up elections said elections for workers' college will be held on September 26.
- Number of Moroccan expatriates returning home on holiday has started decreasing since Monday.
- Minister Driss Basri says general elections might be delayed from planned schedule.
- U.S. International Development Agency (USAID) signed a convention with Morocco to promote education of girls in rural areas.
